title: The Wild Mountain Blossom (U Tiew Pathaw)
khasi_title: U Tiew Pathaw ha Ri Lum
cultural_context: Folk lyric celebrating the humble yellow wildflower growing on mountain stone crevices. Unlike pampered garden blossoms, it withstands fierce rainstorms and chilly winds without wilting, symbolizing the resilience, modesty (ka akor), and inner strength of the Khasi people.
lyrics_khasi:
Ha ki mawsiang ba eh me mih khlem pisa,
Ko tiew-pathaw ba stem kum ka ksiar!
La ka erlang ka shoh, la ka slap ka theh,
Me rkhie pynban ha la ka jinglong!

Ym don ba thung, ym don ba sumar,
U Blei Nongthaw u ai ia ka bor;
Kumta to long ka akor jong ngi,
Ban neh triang ha ka Hok bad ka Sot!
lyrics_english:
Upon hard granite boulders thou sprouteth without complaint,
O wild blossom glowing golden like pure amber!
Though biting gale winds strike and heavy rains pour down,
Thou smilest still in gentle contentment!

No human hand planted thee, no gardener tended thee,
God the Creator alone imparted thy strength;
Even so let our moral character stand,
Steadfast forever in Righteousness and Truth!

stanzas.title: U Tiew-Pathaw ha Mawsiang (Blossom on the Rocks)
stanzas.khasi:
Ha ki mawsiang ba eh me mih khlem pisa,
Ko tiew-pathaw ba stem kum ka ksiar!
La ka erlang ka shoh, la ka slap ka theh,
Me rkhie pynban ha la ka jinglong!
stanzas.english: On hard rocks you sprout without sorrow, wild yellow flower bright as gold! Though gales buffet and rain drenches, you smile in serene grace.

stanzas.title: Ka Akor ba Neh Triang (Enduring Virtue)
stanzas.khasi:
Ym don ba thung, ym don ba sumar,
U Blei Nongthaw u ai ia ka bor;
Kumta to long ka akor jong ngi,
Ban neh triang ha ka Hok bad ka Sot!
stanzas.english: Unplanted by human hand, God alone gives you strength; so let our character endure, grounded in Truth and Righteousness!

vocabulary.tiew-pathaw: Wild yellow rock flower, resilient indigenous mountain blossom
vocabulary.erlang: Fierce gale-force mountain storm wind mixed with driving rain
vocabulary.akor: Moral etiquette, decorum, polite behavior, internal character
vocabulary.sot: Truth, purity of intention, integrity without deception
